articles.title: India, Japan agree to bolster defense ties
articles.summary: Japan's Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi visited New Delhi, inspecting a guard of honour. India and Japan agreed to significantly bolster security ties during this high-level engagement. This strategic commitment aims to enhance defence cooperation, crucial for regional stability and mutual security interests, reflecting growing bilateral alignment between both nations.

This initiative underscores advancements in material science and manufacturing capabilities. articles.title: North Korea fires up to 10 ballistic missiles toward sea, hours after Trump speaks of re-engagement
articles.summary: South Korea condemned North Korea's launch of over 10 short-range ballistic missiles, ordering its military to maintain full readiness. This incident occurred amidst ongoing joint exercises between South Korea and the US, heightening regional tensions. Seoul called the launches a clear provocation, underscoring the volatile security situation on the Korean Peninsula and the need for robust defence preparedness.
